frames.title: Score: a step every four bars

notes.text: **This patch is its own score.** Two **Trigger Sequencers** take one step every four bars, and their 32 steps are the whole song. Each lane is a part: its velocity sets that part's fader for the next four bars, gliding through a **Sample & Hold**'s Slew, and its gate presses a Looper pedal, strikes the crash or holds the riser.

**The motif** is four bars of quarter notes. A lone sine plays it first, and the **Looper** keeps four bars of it, set to play back reversed at half speed: in the breakdown the rack remembers how it began. At the lift the same notes return as a seven-voice supersaw.

The score's drum lane picks the pattern: **A** silence, **B** a pulse, **C** the groove, **D** a build. For a fill, a **Clock Divider** opens a gate in each unit's last bar, **Logic** lets it through when the score asks, and a quarter more CV turns C into D for one bar.
